name: sounds
description: Toasts and configurable sounds for Claude Code: usage limits, context, prompt-cache expiry and every way a turn ends (Claude mod)

soundLimit5h.title: Sound: 5-hour limit
soundLimit5h.description: Plays when the 5-hour window passes 80%, 90% and 100%.

soundLimit7d.title: Sound: 7-day limit
soundLimit7d.description: Plays when the 7-day window passes 80%, 90% and 100%.

soundLimitSpend.title: Sound: spend limit
soundLimitSpend.description: Plays when a gateway spend limit passes 80%, 90% and 100%.

soundContext.title: Sound: context
soundContext.description: Plays when the context window passes 80% and 90%.

soundCacheExpiring.title: Sound: cache expiring
soundCacheExpiring.description: Plays one minute before the prompt cache expires.

soundCacheExpired.title: Sound: cache expired
soundCacheExpired.description: Plays when the prompt cache has expired.

soundDone.title: Sound: turn finished
soundDone.description: Plays when a turn ends with an answer and took at least the seconds below.

soundAborted.title: Sound: turn interrupted
soundAborted.description: Plays when a turn is interrupted.

soundRefused.title: Sound: model refused
soundRefused.description: Plays when the model refuses a turn.

soundError.title: Sound: API error
soundError.description: Plays when an API error or the context limit ends a turn.

soundSubagent.title: Sound: subagent finished
soundSubagent.description: Plays when a subagent finishes a turn.

doneAfterSeconds.title: Sound: shortest turn
doneAfterSeconds.description: Turns shorter than this many seconds do not play the finished sound; 0 plays after every answer.
